Indirect compensation (Cc into the cascode source) pushes p2 to about gm7*Cc/(C1*CL) and removes the RHP zero. The weak-inversion input pair (gm/Id 22, 10.5 uA) gives GBW = gm1/Cc. The class-A output (16 uA, near rail-to-rail) gives swing and slew. vcasn comes for free from a resistor in series with the reference diode. Total is 36.5 uA, about 66 uW."}

PARAMS = {
    "gmid1": (22.0, 14.0, 26.0),     # input pair gm/Id (weak inversion, efficiency)
    "L1":    (0.8, 0.3, 2.0),        # input pair L (flicker noise / gain)
    "Itail": (10.5e-6, 6e-6, 14e-6), # first-stage tail current
    "gmidp": (11.0, 7.0, 15.0),      # PMOS mirror load gm/Id
    "Lp":    (0.8, 0.4, 2.0),        # PMOS mirror L
    "gmid7": (15.0, 10.0, 16.0),     # output PMOS gm/Id (low Vdsat, high gm7)
    "L7":    (0.5, 0.3, 1.0),        # output PMOS L
    "Iout":  (16e-6, 12e-6, 20e-6),  # output stage current
    "Cc":    (0.5e-12, 0.3e-12, 0.9e-12),
    "gmidb": (15.0, 10.0, 20.0),     # NMOS mirrors (ref, tail, output sink) gm/Id
    "Lb":    (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),        # NMOS mirror L
    "gmidc": (18.0, 10.0, 22.0),     # NMOS cascode gm/Id
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    vdd = 1.8
    cl = spec.get("cl", 2e-12)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    vcm = spec.get("vcm", 0.9)

    Itail = p["Itail"]
    Iout = p["Iout"]
    # keep total supply current within the power budget (68 uW / 1.8 V = 37.8 uA)
    imax = 36.6e-6 - iref
    if Itail + Iout > imax:
        Iout = max(imax - Itail, 8e-6)
    Ih = Itail / 2
    Cc = p["Cc"]
    Lc = 0.5

    # ---- input pair (account for body effect, source at tail node) ----
    vtail = 0.45
    for _ in range(3):
        m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], Ih, vds=0.2, vsb=vtail)
        vtail = max(vcm - m1.vgs, 0.2)
    vd1 = vtail + 0.17                    # drain of input pair (cascode source)
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], Ih, vds=vd1 - vtail, vsb=vtail)

    # ---- NMOS cascodes ----
    mc = lut.size("n", p["gmidc"], Lc, Ih, vds=0.3, vsb=vd1)
    vcasn = vd1 + mc.vgs

    # ---- PMOS mirror load ----
    m3 = lut.size("p", p["gmidp"], p["Lp"], Ih, vds=0.95)
    m4 = m3

    # ---- output stage ----
    m7 = lut.size("p", p["gmid7"], p["L7"], Iout, vds=0.9)
    # ---- NMOS bias mirrors ----
    mb = lut.size("n", p["gmidb"], p["Lb"], iref, vds=0.5)
    m5 = lut.size("n", p["gmidb"], p["Lb"], Itail, vds=vtail)
    m8 = lut.size("n", p["gmidb"], p["Lb"], Iout, vds=0.9)

    # resistor in series with reference diode generates vcasn at the ibias pin
    Rcas = max((vcasn - mb.vgs) / iref, 1e3)

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    # bias
    n.R("Rcas", "ibias", "nb", Rcas)
    n.dev("Mb", "nb", "nb", "vss", "vss", mb)
    n.dev("M5", "tail", "nb", "vss", "vss", m5)
    # first stage: vinp on the output (x) side -> non-inverting overall
    n.dev("M1", "a1", "vinn", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "a2", "vinp", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M1c", "d1", "ibias", "a1", "vss", mc)
    n.dev("M2c", "x", "ibias", "a2", "vss", mc)
    n.dev("M3", "d1", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M4", "x", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", m4)
    # second stage
    n.dev("M7", "vout", "x", "vdd", "vdd", m7)
    n.dev("M8", "vout", "nb", "vss", "vss", m8)
    # indirect (cascode) Miller compensation into low-impedance cascode source
    n.C("Cc", "vout", "a2", Cc)

    # ---- first-order predictions ----
    gm1 = m1.gm
    rcas = (mc.gm + mc.gmbs) / (mc.gds * m1.gds + 1e-30)  # cascoded NMOS conductance inverse
    g1 = m4.gds + 1.0 / rcas
    A1 = gm1 / g1
    A2 = m7.gm / (m7.gds + m8.gds)
    A0 = A1 * A2
    ugbw = gm1 / (2 * PI * Cc)
    C1 = m7.cgg + m4.cdd + mc.cdd + 5e-15
    fp2 = m7.gm * Cc / (C1 * (cl + Cc)) / (2 * PI)
    fcas = mc.gm / (2 * PI * (mc.cgg + m1.cdd + 2e-15))
    fmir = m3.gm / (2 * PI * (m3.cgg + m4.cgg + m3.cdd))
    pm = 90 - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / fp2)) - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / fcas)) \
         - 0.5 * math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / fmir))
    slew = min(Itail / Cc, Iout / (cl + Cc))
    tau = 1 / (2 * PI * ugbw)
    settle = 0.8 / slew + 5 * tau
    kT4 = 4 * 1.38e-23 * 300
    noise_th = math.sqrt(2 * kT4 * 0.8 / gm1 * (1 + m3.gm / gm1))
    noise_1k = 4 * noise_th  # crude flicker allowance
    cmrr = A1 * 2 * m3.gm / m5.gds
    swing = vdd - (max(m7.vdsat, 0.08) + max(m8.vdsat, 0.08))
    power = vdd * (iref + Itail + Iout)

    return n, {
        "gain_db": db(A0),
        "ugbw": ugbw,
        "pm": pm,
        "slew": slew,
        "settle": settle,
        "noise_1k": noise_1k,
        "cmrr_db": db(cmrr),
        "psrr_db": db(A0) - 6,
        "swing": swing,
        "power": power,
    }
